No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you compare two urban architectural expressions using UNESCO-listed ensembles.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Fort precinct Gothic facades
  • Maidan urban axis
  • Art Deco frontage observation
  • Architecture-and-modernity discussion

How the time is spent

  1. Fort precinct Gothic facades 25 min

  2. Maidan urban axis 45 min

  3. Art Deco frontage observation 45 min

  4. Architecture-and-modernity discussion 35 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify the features of Victorian Gothic facades in the Fort precinct.
  • Recognise Art Deco frontages and compare them with Gothic buildings across the Maidan.
  • Discuss what these two architectural styles show about architecture and modernity in the city.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
